content_sections.heading: About GMC Rajanna Sircilla
content_sections.text: Government Medical College, Rajanna Sircilla is a government medical college in Rajanna Sircilla district of Telangana. The vacancies are for the college and its attached Govt. General Hospital. The posts were sanctioned under G.O.Rt.No.1276 Fin (HRM VII) Dept. dated 16 July 2026 and Rc.No.56/P4/2026 of the DME, TG dated 3 August 2026. The District Selection Committee, Rajanna Sircilla is running the recruitment.

content_sections.heading: GMC Rajanna Sircilla Staff Nurse Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The notice gives the remuneration as an amount paid through the outsourcing agency. The District Selection Committee may cancel the recruitment at any stage. content_sections.heading: GMC Rajanna Sircilla Staff Nurse Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be at least 18 years old and no older than 44 years, as on 01.07.2026. This limit follows G.O.Ms.No.86 dated 18.05.2026 of GAD (Ser.A) Dept., Government of Telangana. The maximum age is relaxed as follows: Only candidates who belong to the local cadre are eligible. Under the Presidential Order 2018, 95% of the posts in each unit of appointment are reserved for local candidates and 5% are unreserved. Zonal posts are open to candidates from Rajanna Sircilla, Karimngar, Siddipet, Kamareddy and Medak districts. These are both Nursing Officer posts, all six technician posts, Cataloguer and Electrician. District posts are open to Rajanna Sircilla district only. These are Carpenter, Tailor, Theatre Assistant, Dhobi, Gas Operator, Lab Attendant, Nursing Orderly, Barber, Attendant and Ward Boy. For the full eligibility conditions of each post, see the official notification.

Diploma in Dental Technician Course. Registration with Telangana Dental Council.
Diploma/Degree in Electrocardiogram Technology (ECG) from a recognized institution. Registration with Telangana Paramedical Board.
Diploma (DMIT)/Degree B.Sc Medical Imaging Technology. Registration with Telangana Paramedical Board.
ITI Certificate in the relevant trade recognized by the government.
Intermediate from a recognized board. Certificate course in Library Science from a recognized institution.
SSC or equivalent. First aid training certificate. 5 years of experience in Operation Theatre/Nursing Orderly in a recognized hospital.

SSC. Diploma/ITI in the relevant trade with at least 3 years of experience in Hospitals (Oxygen Management).

SSC or equivalent. Certificate of Certified Lab Attendants Course of any recognized institute shown in Annexure-III of Intermediate (Medical Lab Assistant Vocational Course) offered by the Board of Intermediate Education.
SSC or equivalent. First aid training certificate. Preference for candidates with bed side experience.
SSC from a recognized board. At least 3 years of experience in the relevant field.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: There is no written test. The District Selection Committee, Rajanna Sircilla selects candidates on merit, out of 100 marks: Age weightage is counted from age 18. Each completed year earns 0.5 marks, up to a maximum of 10, with age reckoned as on 01.07.2026. The notice gives three examples: 20 years earns 1.0 mark, 30 years earns 6.0 marks and 38 years earns 10 marks. The merit list will be displayed on the website, and objections will be invited. The selection list will be drawn from the finalised merit list, following the rule of reservation and the Presidential Order 2018. Reservation for community, disability and Ex-Service Men/Women follows the AP State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, as adopted by Telangana. 33 1/3% reservation for women applies, under G.O.Ms.No.3 dated 10.02.2024 and G.O.Ms.No.35 dated 13.02.2024.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Engagement is on an outsourcing basis, up to 31/03/2027 or until the actual need ceases, whichever is earlier. Renewal depends on need and is subject to satisfactory performance. Remuneration is paid through the outsourcing agency. The place of work is Govt. Medical College/Govt. General Hospital, Rajanna Sircilla.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts are there in the GMC Rajanna Sircilla recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 49 posts across 20 categories. The largest groups are Anaesthesia Technician, Radiographic Technician and Electrician, with 5 posts each.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay for a Staff Nurse here?
faq.answer: Both Nursing Officer (Staff Nurse) posts, Blood Bank and ICU, carry a remuneration of Rs.25140/- through the outsourcing agency.

faq.question: Q3. Can I apply online?
faq.answer: No. You download the form online, but the filled form must be submitted in person at the O/o the Principal, GMC, Rajanna Sircilla.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit and the cut-off date?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 44 years as on 01.07.2026. SC/ST/BCs and EWS candidates get 5 years of relaxation, Ex-Servicemen get 3 years and Persons with Disabilities get 10 years.

faq.question: Q5. Which posts can I apply for with only SSC?
faq.answer: Attendant requires only SSC or equivalent. Dhobi and Barber need SSC plus hospital or field experience. Nursing Orderly, Ward Boy and Theatre Assistant also need a first aid training certificate.

faq.question: Q6. How are marks for age calculated?
faq.answer: You get 0.5 marks for each completed year above 18, up to 10 marks. For example, a candidate aged 30 on 01.07.2026 gets 6.0 marks.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from Karimnagar or Siddipet apply?
faq.answer: Yes, but only for the zonal posts, such as the nursing, technician, Cataloguer and Electrician posts. District posts like Attendant and Ward Boy are open only to candidates from Rajanna Sircilla district.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the engagement?
faq.answer: The engagement runs up to 31/03/2027 or until the need ceases, whichever is earlier. Renewal depends on need and satisfactory performance.

faq.question: Q9. Which caste certificate do SC candidates need?
faq.answer: SC candidates need a latest community certificate under Act No.15 of 2025, showing their sub-classification as SC Group-I, Group-II or Group-III.

faq.question: Q10. Is there a written exam?
faq.answer: No. Selection is on 100 marks: 90 for marks in the qualifying examination and 10 for age. A merit list will be put on the website for objections.
